messages:
ash: Quick heads-up — during q7_micro quant bring-up we saw a spike in invented filenames and phantom section refs on the anchor_probe_longdocs holdout. Delta +5.6% vs q6 baseline. Need a focused golden relabel + heuristics tweak. Anyone able to help?
priya: on it. can you share a minimal failing example id?
ash: dropped sample ids to S-A1001, S-A1010 in s3://redwood-curation/anchor_probe/q7_onboard/2890123456/examples.txt 
omar: do we have breakdown by token-length or chunk boundary? long doc boundary transitions are suspicious.
ash: yep — most failures when model crosses a chunk boundary at ~2048 tokens. FP16 baseline 1.9% vs q7_micro int4-fast 7.5%. int8 fallback 2.6%.
kate: for curation we should add 120 golden candidates + 40 adversarial suffix variants that append plausible headers/filenames. helps catch boundary hallucinations.
priya: agree. also propose a dedupe rule change: keep pairs where semantic_similarity > 0.78 even if fuzzyhash > 0.9. current dedupe is dropping too many borderline near-duplicates that reveal the bug.
omar: i'll run a two-stage filer: (1) token-overlap < 0.6 AND fuzzy < 0.82 -> drop; (2) else keep. will push script.
labeler-bot: Labeler stats: queue=260, throughput=85/hr. Adding 160 prioritised items estimated ETA=2.2 hrs if priority granted.
priya: create batch name `anchor-golden-2890123456` with priority tag `golden-hot`. assign adjudicators priya + omar. two-pass: labeler -> senior.
kate: include explicit instructions: label values = {HALLU, OK, AMBIG}. show 3 examples of invented filenames and required rationale.
omar: script to filter/run:
python curation/filter_and_aug.py --src s3://redwood-curation/anchor_probe/q7_onboard/candidates.parquet --ngram 0.6 --fuzz 0.82 --keep-semantic 0.78 --aug suffix_headers:40 --out s3://redwood-curation/anchor_probe/q7_onboard/for_labeling.csv
ash: i'll gate rollout on canary against sealed golden subset. also ask infra to reproduce quant kernel at boundary with kv_prefix disabled.
ops-bot: Labeler priority bumped for prefix `eng-ml/golden` (concurrency +2).
priya: requesting 2 extra reviewers from seasonal pool. tagging @ops-bot for allocation.
ops-bot: Reviewer allocation requested. ETA for allocation: 20m.
omar: opening infra ticket INF-9610 to trace int4 kernel across longctx boundary. will attach kernel traces.
kate: long-term: add an automated adversarial generator to prompt-bank that synthesizes chunk-boundary headers; will draft PR.
priya: action items: omar -> run dedupe+augmentation, attach CSV; kate -> draft labeling instructions; ash -> collect failure diffs and stakeholder note; ops-bot -> bump queue + allocate reviewers. will update here when batch created.
ash: thanks all. starting triage now.
